answer: Require each identity to post a unique sable dye lot as a burned admission bond, then grow one piece of counterparty work under a juniper seal that two uncorrelated stewards photograph. A public mirror of those photographs and the dye lot is checked for reuse; any recycled lot or repeated steward pair is rejected. A sybil factory cannot mass-register names because each alias consumes a unique dye lot, a fresh steward pair, and a seal that the mirror will not accept twice.
